fix_verification_labels_did_not_move: PASS: all 65 commits of that session were replayed through both clusterers into the real CommunitySpeakerIdentity, with the comparison tool itself checked against the device-recorded clusterToFrozenId (65/65 agree). Below the cap the real data is bit-identical; above it internal labels differ by at most 9.61%, but after the registry absorbs them the public speaker disagrees for 5.90 s / 7332 s (0.08%), of which a genuine named-to-named swap is 0.61 s (0.0083%). No slot ever loses its label.
fix_verification_demo_source_builds: PASS, and this round is the reason the fix exists. The 0.3.24 package built before the fix did NOT compile as shipped: SdkSelfTest.ets imports PoliceEnhancePipeline from 'amphion_police', a module that ships only in the diagnostics SDK, so CompileArkTS failed with 10505001 'Cannot find module amphion_police'. Same defect class as 0.3.23's MindirProbe.ets. The packer now strips those cases and its gate checks every bare import against the declared dependencies instead of one known-internal name; test_complete_delivery_package.py asserts the same invariant over the produced ZIP and fails against the old packer.

uncovered_scenarios: The 7332 s verification audio is one recording looped, so the speaker count reaches the cap early. Neither 'long silence then a new speaker' nor the short-run candidate cap was exercised; the former is the only mechanism that could renumber a public speaker. Recorded in docs/speaker/DIARIZATION_CLUSTERING_BOUND_20261016.md.
signing_and_license_provenance: DevEco-managed signing-project material bound to the demo bundle and listing this device's UDID. The repository's .secure/signing/asr-demo certificate and profile both expired 2026-09-15 and cannot sign.
